# Comments UI (`components/accounting/comments/`)

`CommentsPanel` (thread + add box for one record) with `CommentItem` (one comment, own Edit/Delete) and `CommentComposer` (the text box, shared by add and edit); `commentsApi.ts` is the only caller of `/api/accounting/record-comments` (each call `assertOk`s: apiFetch resolves on 4xx). Service side: `src/modules/accounting/services/comments/.claude.md`.

## Caller contract
- `<CommentsPanel recordType recordId />`, mounted on: the invoice drawer (`InvoiceDrawerBody`), the full invoice page, the bill page, and the bank line drawer. A mention's link must land on one of these (`commentRecordHref`; `tests/unit/components/commentsMounts*.test.tsx` render each host and assert the type and id).
- Everyone who can open the record reads the thread; only owner/admin/manager (`canWrite`) see the add box, and only the author sees Edit/Delete. The server enforces both.
- Plain text only: bodies are rendered as text (`whitespace-pre-wrap`), never as HTML.
- Mention picker: the kit `Select` ("Mention a colleague"); picking appends "@Name " and records the id; a name deleted from the text drops the mention. No roster (read-only role, or nobody else) means no picker.

## Keyboard and focus
- Escape in a box holding text keeps its Escape (`data-keeps-escape`, honoured by `useFocusTrap`): add box leaves the box, edit box cancels the edit; the drawer stays open and the draft is kept. Empty box: Escape closes the drawer as before. Escape in an open Select closes only its list.
- Focus never falls to BODY: post, then the add box; Edit, then the edit box; Save or cancel, then that comment's Edit button; Delete, then the add box.
- Over 4000 characters: a sentence tied to the box (`aria-describedby`), Comment disabled.
